title: Knowledge base
description: What an extension's program may ask of the knowledge base directly (docs/extensions/extensions.md "Knowledge base RPC"): kb.list, kb.recent, kb.get, kb.day, kb.search, kb.owner (permission kb.read) and kb.update (kb.write), and the events event.kb.changed / event.kb.forgotten. An extension's kb.update is attributed to it: it may not touch what the user or another extension holds (conflict), and it holds the locked fields it writes (docs/assistant/knowledge.md "Who holds a field"). Params are strict: no contribution, and an unknown field is invalid_params. A connector hands the knowledge base its conversations, items and posts through the connector calls instead (connector.schema.json). Plugin-side: only the hub and the program speak it.

KBErrorCode.description: error.code of a knowledge-base call besides permission_denied (data {scope}, the one missing): invalid_params, not_found, assistant_offline (the manager is away), kb_unavailable (not open yet), conflict (kb.update touches fields the user or another extension holds; data KBConflict, nothing was written). assistant_offline and kb_unavailable are worth trying again; conflict is for the user to decide.

KBConflict.description: The data of a conflict error: field → who holds it (user, or ext:<extension id>); a linked entity's field is <kind>/<id>.<field>.

KBEvidence.description: What a written value rests on: a chat's day (kb.day) and optionally the line n there.

day.description: YYYY-MM-DD in the knowledge base's time zone.

n.description: 1-based line in that day's file (kb.day's n).

KBProvenance.description: An entry of an entity's meta.provenance (kb.get): which extension holds that locked field, since when, from what. A locked field without one is the user's.

KBHandle.description: An identity clue: kind (phone, email, a source's user id kind…) and the raw value.

KBListParams.description: kb.list: one kind's entities, ranked; pages are not a snapshot (deduplicate, read again when needed).

since.description: An RFC 3339 time: only entities updated at or after it (a chat: its last message).

next_offset.description: Where the next page starts; none at the end.

relevance.description: 0–100: how much it concerns the owner.

extra.description: A project's short / long · status, a chat's dm / group…

source.description: A chat's source (lark, mail, wechat, github…).

KBRecentParams.description: kb.recent (kb.read): what came in from every source in [since, until), newest first, across kinds: one feed for a curation pass. Read a chat's text with kb.day, anything else with kb.get.

until.description: An RFC 3339 time; none is now.

kinds.description: None is chats, docs, meetings, events and recordings.

KBGetParams.description: kb.get: one entity, with its most recent messages (recent_chars, none is 12000; 0 leaves them out). Live agents are not in it.

path.description: Where it is on the manager's machine, for its own file tools.

meta.description: The entity's own fields (meta.json). For people, status is active, ignored or self; absent or empty means active. Status uses the same locked_fields and provenance as other corrected fields.

minutes.description: A recording's meeting minutes, once written (docs/assistant/meeting-minutes.md); kept as the hub sends them.

recap.description: An all-day recording's day recap, once written (docs/assistant/day-recap.md); kept as the hub sends them.

KBTopicPoint.description: One knowledge point of a topic, under up to two levels of subtopics (path).

why.description: A decision's reason, a pitfall's cause.

when.description: YYYY-MM-DD: when it was last confirmed.

KBTopicSource.description: An entry a knowledge point came from.

KBMomentRef.description: A feed post linked to a project.

note.description: How it bears on the project.

KBRecordingSegment.description: A recording's transcript segment, in seconds from its start.

n.description: An all-day recording's line number: the segment's 1-based position in its uploads (docs/assistant/day-recap.md); absent on other recordings.

KBDayParams.description: kb.day: a chat's messages of one day in the knowledge base's time zone.

day.description: YYYY-MM-DD, a real date (the hub refuses 2026-13-45).

KBDayResult.description: prev and next are the days before and after that have messages (empty: none).

sent_origin.description: available means ledger matching ran, not that unmarked messages are human-authored. missing_scope requires sent.read; unavailable means the service cannot provide provenance. Older hosts omit this field: treat absence as unavailable.

n.description: The message's first line in the day's file, from 1.

sent_by.description: Present only for a unique match in the sent-as-user ledger, with sent.read.

recalled_at.description: When this matched send was recalled; the archive may still contain its text.

KBSearchParams.description: kb.search: lines that match, messages too unless messages is false.

query.description: Not only spaces (the hub refuses that).

KBUpdateParams.description: kb.update: kind and id, and the fields to change (the knowledge base's update API, plus pinned, lock and the remove_* lists). A field left out is kept; the other lists add to what is there. Protected fields and history limits: docs/assistant/knowledge.md.

pinned.description: Confirmed facts automatic writes cannot replace; an empty string clears them.

lock.description: Whether an importance / relevance given here is kept from automatic tagging (default true).

status.description: People: active, ignored or self; other values are rejected by kb.update. Projects: active, paused, done or ignored. Omitted or empty keeps the current status; active restores a person.

tags.description: Replaces the tags; an empty list clears them, none keeps them.

log.description: A project's: a line appended to its timeline.

merge_into.description: Refused (conflict) when the user or another extension holds anything on the project folded away; no before.

evidence.description: Kept as the provenance of the fields this write holds.

unlock.description: Fields this extension holds, handed back to the built-in pipeline; unlocking pinned clears it.

before.description: The previous value of each field written (null when unset; summary is the old text), for the extension's own undo.

KBOwner.description: kb.owner: the user's name, aliases and identities across sources (raw only through this explicit read).

KBChangedEvent.description: event.kb.changed: an entity changed (what: which part). Read it again if it matters.

KBForgottenEvent.description: event.kb.forgotten: a source's data was removed from the knowledge base.
